title: Drawer
api:
interface DrawerProps {
  trigger?: ReactElement
  title: string
  description?: string
  children?: ReactNode
  footer?: ReactNode
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  disabled?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  className?: string
  initialFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['initialFocus']
  finalFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['finalFocus']
}

function Drawer({
  trigger,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  open,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  disabled,
  size = 'md',
  className,
  initialFocus,
  finalFocus,
}: DrawerProps);
notes: Drawer is a bottom modal with a required title. Preserve its focus management and keyboard-accessible dismissal.
Use the component’s existing pointer/keyboard handle; do not make swipe the only way to close.
